_comment: EXAMPLE · Salesforce REPORT source — reading Analytics reports (TABULAR only; summary/matrix are grouped and unsupported) instead of running SOQL. Unlike `queries`, `reports` takes MANY entries: one output slot and one output table per report (read_many). Five publishers: read_by_id / read_by_name (an entry is a report id or a name; find_report_by breaks the tie, and the emitted @td.salesforce.report_id records the RESOLVED id — plus column_name_strategy, where "label" gives display names that change whenever someone edits the report, so prefer the API-name default for anything a pipeline consumes), read_many, read_filtered (server-side (column, operator, value) filters applied BEFORE the download, so they cut transfer; filter_logic combines them by 1-BASED POSITION, which means reordering `filter` changes its meaning), read_recent (last_modified_column + initial_last_modified — ALL-OR-NOTHING, validated at decoration time; a static floor, like the SOQL one). NO TRIGGERS ON PURPOSE: a report is org content the salesforce model does not create, so the suite registers the publishers and fires none — a run stays green on an org with no reports. Put a real report id/name in the constants and trigger one by hand: `tdk fn trigger --proj <project> --coll reports --name read_by_name`. One function per file under functions/salesforce_report/. Run: `tdx-xp oneshot --suite examples/salesforce_report --keep`.
